<h2>Reconcile Programmatic Trait Review Candidates</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Applies conservative deterministic checks to pending trait-review
candidates. It proposes rules only for obsolete candidates, independently
corroborated dataset factors, or threshold rules that improve current
within-candidate agreement. Other candidates remain pending or are routed
to targeted agent review.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_trait_review_programmatic_reconciliation(
  data_candidate_triage,
  data_source_pairs,
  data_submission_audit,
  data_record_evidence,
  evidence_reference
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_candidate_triage">data_candidate_triage</code></td>
<td>
<p>Candidate triage from [build_trait_review_programmatic_triage()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_source_pairs">data_source_pairs</code></td>
<td>
<p>Candidate source-pair evidence from the programmatic triage.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_submission_audit">data_submission_audit</code></td>
<td>
<p>Derived review-submission audit containing the archived instructions.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_record_evidence">data_record_evidence</code></td>
<td>
<p>Current record evidence from [build_trait_review_evidence_packets()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="evidence_reference">evidence_reference</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-empty path to the human-readable reconciliation report.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A named list containing one reconciliation row per pending candidate,
unapproved decision proposals, and an outcome summary.
</p>
